newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga pays $1,23 bln for Kuwait's Santa Fe.
newsitem.headline: Saga pays $1,23 bln for Kuwait's Santa Fe.

text.p: Norway's largest independent oil company Saga Petroleum ASA said on Wednesday it had agreed to buy Kuwaiti-owned North Sea exploration group Santa Fe Exploration Ltd for $1.23 bln.

The deal, with state-owned Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC), is the second largest acquisition by a Norwegian company following Kvaerner's takeover of British conglomerate Trafalgar House Plc in April for 8.9 billion crowns ($1.4 billion).
Saga said the acquisition would raise its oil production by 50,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 190,000 bpd.
It estimated that the deal would result in more than 15 percent return on equity after tax. The takeover would be financed without raising new equity, Saga added.
